page: UpCloud GPU-20xCPU-256GB-1xL4 is a GPU-accelerated virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 20 shared vCPUs and a memory capacity of 256.0 GB, yielding 12.8 GB of RAM per core. The server includes a single NVIDIA L4 GPU based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, equipped with 24 GB of VRAM.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning external storage volumes must be attached for persistent data. It comes with one complimentary public IPv4 address. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the shared CPU allocation model combined with a high memory-to-core ratio and dedicated GPU acceleration provides a specialized resource profile for workloads requiring GPU compute without the cost of dedicated physical CPU cores.
The hardware configuration makes this server suitable for workloads such as machine learning inference, data science tasks, video transcoding, and memory-intensive GPU-accelerated applications.
